name: Aaron Fox
role: Wrote of a row-boat trip down the Little Missouri
mentions: Messrs. A. and E. Fox and Fred Hartman, of Minnieska, Minn., and Rev. J. W. Klepper, of Mandan, Dak., started Tuesday afternoon on a unique trip. They brought a boat from Mandan and are going…
